title: CP2 Viscosity by the Falling-Ball Method Core Practical
description: Edexcel IAL Physics core practical 2: find the viscosity of glycerol with a falling-ball method. Read the micrometer and the rule, time each ball between the bands, plot v against r² and find η from the gradient using Stokes’ law.
